newsitem.title: USA: Ill. $100 mln GOs for sale July 22 AA - Fitch.
newsitem.headline: Ill. $100 mln GOs for sale July 22 AA - Fitch.

text.p: Fitch Investors Service has assigned a AA rating to $100 million of tax-exempt general obligation bonds Illinois has set for competitive sale Tuesday.
Fitch also affirmed the AA rating of the state's $5.1 billion outstanding general obligation debt, the service said in a statement.
The sale is the first of general obligation debt for Illinois in fiscal 1998.

"The credit strength of Illinois rests with the breadth, diversity and wealth of the economy and the very moderate burden that debt places on those resources, although financial operations, while improving, are not yet strong," Fitch said.
The services sector has grown to become the major employment source, but the still prominent manufacturing sector continues to make the state vulnerable to recession, Fitch said.
"The better economic climate and state actions to control costs have helped to improve the financial position, which deteriorated in the most recent recession," Fitch said.
